headline_addon.signal: BLOCK z (validated long-history signal for energy and food PCE, OOS 1975-2026); segment z shown for context
headline_addon.zones: z>=1 strong_up; 0.5..1 up; -0.5..0.5 neutral; -1..-0.5 down; <=-1 strong_down
headline_addon.line_en: Headline add-on (2026-10): commodity block z +0.12. Pressure on energy and food PCE over 3–12M: neutral. Direction only, not a forecast.
headline_addon.line_de: Headline-Zusatz (2026-10): Rohstoffblock z +0.12. Druck auf Energie- und Food-PCE über 3–12M: neutral. Nur Richtung, keine Prognose.
headline_addon.caveats: Validated on current-vintage data only; energy PCE RMSE 2.5–4 % better than AR, food PCE 4–9 % better than AR at 6–12M; food lead strongest since 2008; not valid for core PCE.
